name: nakhsha
description: نخشا — نقشهٔ هنرهای ایران؛ پلتفرم اشتراک و کشف محصولات صنایع‌دستی

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=ci-test-secret-for-jest-only MONGO_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/nakhsha_test npm test --prefix backend
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env NODE_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=ci-test-secret-for-jest-only MONGO_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/nakhsha_test npm run test:coverage --prefix backend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
